name: experiment-F-rb4-boundary-check
description: Experiment F on repair subject rb4-boundary-check: can search-based mutation find valid patches? Random patch search, genetic search and local search (stochastic hill climbing with restarts) with the same budget of candidate evaluations. Success = a plausible patch (passes every search test); the best patch of each run is minimised and validated on held-out tests and against the reference fix.
